frozen_before: any base or fine-tuned model was evaluated on any split

headline.name: field-level exact match (task A)
headline.definition: Over all (passage, field) pairs in the held-out TEST passages (8 fields: channel_id, sensor_type, units, event_date, observation, operational_response, root_cause, evidence), the fraction where the parsed model output equals the gold label from training/tinker/spec.py::label. Lists must match exactly (order included). Text fields are compared after whitespace normalisation. '?' equals an empty/null gold value. Unparseable outputs count as wrong on all 8 fields.
headline.scored_on: raw model output, BEFORE the deterministic validator repairs anything (validator gains reported separately)

companions.valid_schema_rate: fraction of outputs that parse into all 8 fields and validate as a MemoryRecord (target >= 0.99)
companions.per_field_prf: precision/recall/F1 per field, with a prediction counted as positive when non-null
companions.evidence_fidelity: fraction of non-null text-field values that occur verbatim in the passage (target >= 0.99)
companions.unsupported_root_causes: count of non-null root_cause predictions where gold is null or the text is not verbatim (target 0)
companions.null_correctness: accuracy on fields whose gold value is null (correct use of '?')
companions.record_exact_match: fraction of passages with ALL 8 fields correct
companions.validator_catches: number of model errors flagged by the regex/substring validator

statistics.ci: Wilson 95% interval on field-level exact match
statistics.paired_test: exact McNemar test on per-(passage, field) correctness, base vs tuned

comparison: base Qwen3-8B vs Qwen3-8B+LoRA: same system prompt, same user prompt, same parser and validator, temperature 0, thinking disabled

tasks_B_C_D.B: date-set exact match per passage; event vs publication date correctly separated; verbatim sentence rate
tasks_B_C_D.C: citation correct (cited source index == gold), 'not in archive' correct on absent terms, verbatim definition rate
tasks_B_C_D.D: KNOWN/UNKNOWN/ACTION sections present; numbers match the measurements; cited [n] exist; no root-cause claim

test_set_policy: the TEST split is evaluated once per final configuration; iteration uses VAL only
